project.description: Build and tag the PIC-SURE-HPDS service and ETL container images from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace. This job does not compile and does not deploy -- deploy is exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. The former Maven-in-Docker build-bootstrap image is retired; the reactor build now produces both the service jar and the ETL fat-jars directly.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" HPDS_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-hpds"
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
# Guard: the reactor build produces the service jar AND writes the ETL # fat-jars straight into docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/ (assembly outputDirectory). if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] \ || ! ls "$HPDS_DIR"/service/target/service-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1 \ || ! ls "$HPDS_DIR"/docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/*-jar-with-dependencies.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
# Build/tag only. Deploy happens exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE. docker build -f "$HPDS_DIR/docker/pic-sure-hpds/Dockerfile" \ --build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg no_proxy="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg NO_PROXY="$no_proxy" \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" "$HPDS_DIR" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds:LATEST
# HPDS ETL docker build -f "$HPDS_DIR/docker/pic-sure-hpds-etl/Dockerfile" \ --build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy --build-arg no_proxy="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy --build-arg NO_PROXY="$no_proxy" \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" "$HPDS_DIR" docker tag "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-etl:LATEST
